judge_input.description:
### Context

This particular change here goes ahead and adds in a brand new security check, one that is specifically for the case of GCP Compute Engine, and the whole entire job and purpose of this new check is to go and ensure that the custom disk images are not, under any circumstances, being publicly shared out with anyone at all. The underlying reason that this whole thing genuinely matters so much is the fact that images which have ended up being publicly shared are, as a consequence of that, able to go and end up exposing sensitive data of one kind or another, or otherwise proprietary software of some sort, or even quite specific and revealing infrastructure details, and, worse still than all of that, to go and do all of that exposing directly to unauthorized users who should never have had any access at all, which is precisely the sort of thing that ends up creating some genuinely significant and serious security risks in the process along the way.

### Description

What it is that this PR actually does is go right ahead and add in a brand new GCP check, one whose entire purpose is to verify whether or not the Compute Engine custom disk images happen to have any IAM bindings sitting on them at all that would end up having the overall effect of granting some form of public access to them. The way that the check goes about operating is that it goes right through and very carefully evaluates each and every single one of the custom images that there happen to be, and then, once it has finished doing that, it goes on from there to report right back the following particular set of results:

* **PASS**: the image in question here is not, in any way at all, being publicly shared out with anyone whatsoever
* **FAIL**: the image in question here is in fact being publicly shared out, and specifically it is being shared with `allAuthenticatedUsers`

**Note**: it is worth pointing out that, according to what the GCP documentation itself has to say on the matter, `allUsers` simply cannot ever actually be granted any roles at all on images, and so, precisely because of that particular fact, only `allAuthenticatedUsers` is the one that ends up actually being checked for here.

#### Changes include:

**Compute Service (`compute_service.py`):**
- Added an `images` list of its very own, one whose whole and entire job it happens to be to go along and store away all of the various custom image data that there happens to be present
- Added in a brand new `_get_images()` method, one that goes right ahead and does each and every one of the following particular things in turn, one after the other: first of all, it goes and lists out every single one of the custom images that there are, and it does that listing specifically by way of making a call to `images().list()`; then, secondly, it goes and retrieves the full IAM policy for each and every individual one of those images, and it does that specifically by way of making a call to `images().getIamPolicy()`; and then, thirdly and finally, it goes ahead and extracts out all of the public members (that is to say, the `allAuthenticatedUsers` entries) from out of the bindings that were retrieved
- Added in a brand new `Image` model as well, one that comes complete with a `public_members` field sitting right there on it, ready and waiting to hold onto that particular data

**New Check (`compute_image_publicly_shared/`):**
- The check logic its very own self, which is precisely the thing that goes along and evaluates the public sharing status for each and every single one of the images in turn
- A Metadata JSON file of its very own, one that comes along complete with proper and appropriate remediation guidance that is included right there inside of it for reference
- A whole set of unit tests as well, ones that go along and thoroughly cover both the case of the images that do have public sharing on them and also, on the other side of things, the case of the images that do not have it

### Steps to review

1. Go ahead and review the `Image` model, that is, the one that happened to be newly added over to the `compute_service.py` file as part of this work
2. Go ahead and review the `_get_images()` method quite carefully, and in particular these parts of it: the image listing that is done together with pagination handling; the IAM policy retrieval step that gets carried out for each and every single image in turn; and, lastly, the public members extraction logic its very own self
3. Go ahead and review the check logic itself, that is to say, the actual logic that happens to live over inside of the `compute_image_publicly_shared.py` file itself
4. Go ahead and review the `metadata.json` file as well, taking the time to check it over quite carefully and thoroughly for its overall correctness and accuracy throughout the whole of it

### Checklist

- Are there any brand new checks at all, of any kind, that happen to be included as a part of this particular PR right here? Yes / No
    - And if so, if that does indeed turn out to be the case, then do we happen to find ourselves in a position of needing to go and update the permissions for the provider that is in question here? Please do go and take the necessary time to review this particular one over quite carefully and thoroughly.

- [ ] Review whether or not the code is being properly and correctly documented, and whether it is doing so by faithfully following along with this particular specification laid out right here https://github.com/google/styleguide/blob/gh-pages/pyguide.md#38-comments-and-docstrings

+from prowler.lib.check.models import Check, Check_Report_GCP
+from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_client import compute_client
+
+
+class compute_image_not_publicly_shared(Check):
+    """Ensure Compute Engine disk images are not publicly shared.
+
+    This check evaluates whether custom disk images in GCP Compute Engine
+    have IAM bindings that grant access to allAuthenticatedUsers, which allows
+    anyone with a Google account to access the image.
+
+    Note: allUsers cannot be assigned to Compute Engine images (API restriction).
+    Only allAuthenticatedUsers can be set, which is the security risk.
+    Reference: https://cloud.google.com/compute/docs/images/managing-access-custom-images
+
+    - PASS: The disk image is not publicly shared.
+    - FAIL: The disk image is publicly shared with allAuthenticatedUsers.
+    """
+
+    def execute(self) -> list[Check_Report_GCP]:
+        findings = []
+        for image in compute_client.images:
+            report = Check_Report_GCP(
+                metadata=self.metadata(),
+                resource=image,
+                location="global",
+            )
+            report.status = "PASS"
+            report.status_extended = (
+                f"Compute Engine disk image {image.name} is not publicly shared."
+            )
+
+            if image.publicly_shared:
+                report.status = "FAIL"
+                report.status_extended = f"Compute Engine disk image {image.name} is publicly shared with allAuthenticatedUsers."
+
+            findings.append(report)
+
+        return findings

@@ -533,6 +535,52 @@ def _associate_migs_with_load_balancers(self) -> None:
             if (mig.project_id, mig.name) in load_balanced_groups:
                 mig.load_balanced = True
 
+    def _get_images(self) -> None:
+        for project_id in self.project_ids:
+            try:
+                request = self.client.images().list(project=project_id)
+                while request is not None:
+                    response = request.execute(num_retries=DEFAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS)
+                    for image in response.get("items", []):
+                        publicly_shared = False
+                        try:
+                            iam_policy = (
+                                self.client.images()
+                                .getIamPolicy(
+                                    project=project_id, resource=image["name"]
+                                )
+                                .execute(num_retries=DEFAULT_RETRY_ATTEMPTS)
+                            )
+                            for binding in iam_policy.get("bindings", []):
+                                # allUsers cannot be assigned to Compute Engine images (API restriction).
+                                # Only allAuthenticatedUsers can be set, which is the security risk.
+                                if "allAuthenticatedUsers" in binding.get(
+                                    "members", []
+                                ):
+                                    publicly_shared = True
+                                    break
+                        except Exception as error:
+                            logger.error(
+                                f"{project_id}/{image['name']} -- {error.__class__.__name__}[{error.__traceback__.tb_lineno}]: {error}"
+                            )
+
+                        self.images.append(
+                            Image(
+                                name=image["name"],
+                                id=image["id"],
+                                project_id=project_id,
+                                publicly_shared=publicly_shared,
+                            )
+                        )
+
+                    request = self.client.images().list_next(
+                        previous_request=request, previous_response=response
+                    )
+            except Exception as error:
+                logger.error(
+                    f"{project_id} -- {error.__class__.__name__}[{error.__traceback__.tb_lineno}]: {error}"
+                )
+

@@ -0,0 +1,168 @@
+from unittest import mock
+
+from tests.providers.gcp.gcp_fixtures import GCP_PROJECT_ID, set_mocked_gcp_provider
+
+
+class Test_compute_image_not_publicly_shared:
+    def test_compute_no_images(self):
+        compute_client = mock.MagicMock()
+        compute_client.images = []
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.common.provider.Provider.get_global_provider",
+                return_value=set_mocked_gcp_provider(),
+            ),
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_client",
+                new=compute_client,
+            ),
+        ):
+            from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared import (
+                compute_image_not_publicly_shared,
+            )
+
+            check = compute_image_not_publicly_shared()
+            result = check.execute()
+            assert len(result) == 0
+
+    def test_image_not_publicly_shared(self):
+        compute_client = mock.MagicMock()
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.common.provider.Provider.get_global_provider",
+                return_value=set_mocked_gcp_provider(),
+            ),
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_client",
+                new=compute_client,
+            ),
+        ):
+            from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared import (
+                compute_image_not_publicly_shared,
+            )
+            from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_service import Image
+
+            image = Image(
+                name="private-image",
+                id="1234567890",
+                project_id=GCP_PROJECT_ID,
+                publicly_shared=False,
+            )
+
+            compute_client.project_ids = [GCP_PROJECT_ID]
+            compute_client.images = [image]
+
+            check = compute_image_not_publicly_shared()
+            result = check.execute()
+
+            assert len(result) == 1
+            assert result[0].status == "PASS"
+            assert (
+                result[0].status_extended
+                == "Compute Engine disk image private-image is not publicly shared."
+            )
+            assert result[0].resource_id == "1234567890"
+            assert result[0].project_id == GCP_PROJECT_ID
+            assert result[0].resource_name == "private-image"
+            assert result[0].location == "global"
+
+    def test_image_publicly_shared_with_all_authenticated_users(self):
+        from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_service import Image
+
+        image = Image(
+            name="public-image",
+            id="1234567890",
+            project_id=GCP_PROJECT_ID,
+            publicly_shared=True,
+        )
+
+        compute_client = mock.MagicMock()
+        compute_client.project_ids = [GCP_PROJECT_ID]
+        compute_client.images = [image]
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.common.provider.Provider.get_global_provider",
+                return_value=set_mocked_gcp_provider(),
+            ),
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_client",
+                new=compute_client,
+            ),
+        ):
+            from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared import (
+                compute_image_not_publicly_shared,
+            )
+
+            check = compute_image_not_publicly_shared()
+            result = check.execute()
+
+            assert len(result) == 1
+            assert result[0].status == "FAIL"
+            assert (
+                result[0].status_extended
+                == "Compute Engine disk image public-image is publicly shared with allAuthenticatedUsers."
+            )
+            assert result[0].resource_id == "1234567890"
+            assert result[0].project_id == GCP_PROJECT_ID
+            assert result[0].resource_name == "public-image"
+            assert result[0].location == "global"
+
+    def test_multiple_images_mixed_sharing(self):
+        from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_service import Image
+
+        private_image = Image(
+            name="private-image",
+            id="1111111111",
+            project_id=GCP_PROJECT_ID,
+            publicly_shared=False,
+        )
+
+        public_image = Image(
+            name="public-image",
+            id="2222222222",
+            project_id=GCP_PROJECT_ID,
+            publicly_shared=True,
+        )
+
+        compute_client = mock.MagicMock()
+        compute_client.project_ids = [GCP_PROJECT_ID]
+        compute_client.images = [private_image, public_image]
+
+        with (
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.common.provider.Provider.get_global_provider",
+                return_value=set_mocked_gcp_provider(),
+            ),
+            mock.patch(
+                "prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_client",
+                new=compute_client,
+            ),
+        ):
+            from prowler.providers.gcp.services.compute.compute_image_not_publicly_shared.compute_image_not_publicly_shared import (
+                compute_image_not_publicly_shared,
+            )
+
+            check = compute_image_not_publicly_shared()
+            result = check.execute()
+
+            assert len(result) == 2
+
+            private_result = next(
+                r for r in result if r.resource_name == "private-image"
+            )
+            public_result = next(r for r in result if r.resource_name == "public-image")
+
+            assert private_result.status == "PASS"
+            assert (
+                private_result.status_extended
+                == "Compute Engine disk image private-image is not publicly shared."
+            )
+
+            assert public_result.status == "FAIL"
+            assert (
+                public_result.status_extended
+                == "Compute Engine disk image public-image is publicly shared with allAuthenticatedUsers."
+            )
